exclusion_policy: Exclude only the six images in three exact decoded-pixel duplicate pairs with conflicting source labels. All original files are retained unchanged.

related_image_review.status: bounded grouping policy applied; residual identity uncertainty documented in split_metadata.json
related_image_review.candidate_method: 63-bit DCT perceptual hash distance <= 8 OR 64-bit horizontal difference hash distance <= 4; exact pixel duplicates omitted
related_image_review.grouping_policy: Retain useful variations. Keep supported same-object or closely related captures together within a subset. Shared packaging, brand, color, shape, or hash similarity alone does not establish identity.
related_image_review.unresolved_treatment: Use the existing evidence to document a bounded decision for credible leakage risks before splitting. A narrow conservative group may address a supported but uncertain link; generic visual resemblance alone is insufficient. No additional exclusions.
limitations: Physical-object and capture-session identity are not independently verified.
The similarity search and visual review are not exhaustive; residual leakage cannot be ruled out.
Archived group proposals are evidence, not approved assignments.

split.test_use: Held-out test examples remain unused throughout the homework.
